died.name: Pompey
died.cause: to Lucius Septimius, one of his assassins
died.last_words: Surely I am not mistaken, and you are an old comrade of mine!

died.name: Rabbi Akiva
died.cause: reciting the Shema Yisrael while being executed by the Romans
died.last_words: Hear, O Israel! The Lord is our God! The Lord is One!

died.name: Hans Staininger
died.cause: The burgomaster of Braunau am Inn (then Bavaria, now Austria) died when he broke his neck by tripping over his own beard. The beard, which was 4.5 ft long at the time, was usually kept rolled up in a leather pouch.

died.name: George Buchanan
died.cause: when his servant asked who would pay for his burial after Buchanan told him to distribute his property among the poor
died.last_words: It matters little to me; for if I am but once dead they may bury me or not bury me as they please. They may leave my corpse to rot where I die if they wish.

died.name: Herman Melville
died.cause: quoting his final, unfinished novella, Billy Budd

died.name: Pope John Paul I
died.desc: Italian Roman Catholic prelate and Pope
died.cause: who had just elected as Pope following the papal conclave on the death of his predecessor, Pope Paul VI, who died in 6 August
died.last_words: Tomorrow, we will see each other, if the Lord still wishes it, and we will celebrate Mass together.

born.name: Asano Naganori
born.desc: daimyō of the Akō Domain in Japan
born.last_words: I wish I could enjoy / the rest of Spring / as the cherry blossoms are yet in bloom / in spite of the spring breeze / which is attempting to blow off all their petals.

born.name: Inocêncio Francisco da Silva
born.last_words: Farewell, the martyrdom is no more!

born.name: Bhagat Singh
born.desc: Indian revolutionary and Socialist, founder of Hindustan Socialist republican association
